# appgatesdp_appliances_backup_status (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup_id` (String) The Appliance Backup ID given in the initiation response.
- `id` (String) ID of the object.

### Read-Only

- `encoding` (String) Encoding used for the output field
- `message` (String) A free text field that shows what internally the backup is doing.
- `output` (String) The output of the command. Must be checked if result is failure
- `result` (String) Only set when status is done.
- `status` (String) Current status of the Appliance Backup.
